limitations: Exploratory comparison shortlist; no incidence or novelty claim.
Dixon 7286 rows were not retrieved and are not screened.
Published luminosity labels retained alongside changed stellar parameters.
Kepler period maxima are descriptive, with no red-noise or alias significance.
No new flare search or resolved host assignment on the comparison stars.
DASCH and ZTF curves lack the matched controls used for J0754.
Quarter normalization prevents measurement of absolute multi-year fading.
